trajectory.thought: The leader (a10, weighted w=w1) is a seeded baseline and the runner-up margin is statistically indistinguishable. The series is trend-dominated with unstable rankings and highly correlated errors across models, so the meta-model weighting that down-weights redundant models is well-suited. action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.798) with weak seasonality (0.168) and non-stationary. Model rankings are unstable (Kendall tau -0.084) and errors are highly correlated (mean 0.835, only 1 independent group of 7). The meta-model weighting (concentration 0.268) effectively down-weights redundant models and adapts to the unstable ranking, which is exactly what this series needs. The runner-up (dba, 0.665) is not statistically distinguishable from the leader (0.576), confirming that no simpler or more complex combination offers a reliable gain over this weighted approach.
